Name: Baldur's Valley - Astarion Replacement Portrait And Sprite Retexture
Author: GlitchedinOrbit
Description:
[size=3]This mod retextures Astarion's portrait and character sprites.

You need the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20362]Baldur's Valley Replacement Mod[/url] for this retexture to work. It works with the Astarion Only version as well as the full version.

[u][b]Update 1.1: added character sprites![/b][/u]


[b]Installation[/b]
1. Unzip the assets folder
2. Copy the included assets folder
3. Paste and overwrite the assets folder in the Baldur's Valley mod folder (Steam\steamapps\common\Stardew Valley\Mods\Baldur's Valley)
4. Profit
